numeric_mirror_contract.decimal_reverse: Take the exact recorded base-10 decimal numeric representation (not raw source literal for JSON scalars). Preserve sign, reverse digits on either side of decimal as one string; 123.45 -> 54.321, 117 -> 711. Skip exponent notation, nonfinite and values beyond 1e12; report skipped counts.
numeric_mirror_contract.source_context: Preserve exact repository, HEAD revision, source hash, path, line, and original numeric row.

celestial_mirror_contract.interpretation: Pure coordinate transforms not independent astrophysical measurements; original and mirrors must remain separate.

synthetic_mirror_contract.null: Same number of uniform-sky random controls as each selected variant, seeded 20261121.
synthetic_mirror_contract.note: Mirroring arbitrary math literals cannot define an actual sky target without an independently justified decoding rule.

catalog_gate.service: SIMBAD TAP, attempt Harvard and Strasbourg mirrors
catalog_gate.control: Precommitted uniform ICRS directions and their mirrors; match query radius and number; unavailable catalog yields NO_VERDICT.
catalog_gate.multiplicity: Report all attempted directions and group totals; no significance claims from raw nearby-object matches; proper matched sky controls needed.

source_limitations: Original R0 only scans code/default branch of public repos with file-size and extension limits, not 3 private repos; mirror layer inherits same incompleteness.
